Game Overview

The Pond Adventure is a animal title where guide your pelican through vibrant ponds, collecting fish while cleverly evading a mischievous monkey and racing against the clock. With charming characters and increasingly complex levels, this delightful adventure challenges your strategy and reflexes, providing a captivating experience for all ages. Can you outsmart the monkey and conquer the pond?
